## Core Unix commands


Most unix commands have super short names, which makes them quick to type 
but annoying to learn.  Major file system related commands include:
pwd: Print working directory
ls: list files and directories
cd: change directory
mkdir: make a new directory
rm: remove diles and directories (delete) super dangerous
cp: copy files (source > destination)
mv: move files or directories (basically rename)
nano: a wee text command editor (very basic but always available)
